scope_decisions.decision: The v0.2 SRS baseline contains 123 independently traceable requirements: 121 MUST and 2 SHOULD.
NSL-TOL-206 and NSL-VFY-001 are SHOULD requirements; every other v0.2 requirement is MUST.
All v0.2 requirements begin as PLANNED because no v0.2 product behavior has repository implementation evidence at Slice 0032.
The five FROZEN architecture authority documents and CHG-001 through CHG-032 are governed by requirements/nsl_v0_2_readiness.json.
The v0.1 325-requirement baseline remains an independent mandatory regression gate throughout v0.2 development.
Approval routing, user interface, notification, resume scheduling, retry decisions, and reconciliation decisions remain Agent or Platform responsibilities.
NSL-0.2-STRICT safety invariants cannot be weakened by ordinary compiler or runtime options.
Changing requirement text, priority, or membership requires an explicit fingerprint rebaseline and regression evidence.
The v0.2 development and release gate requires statement coverage >= 99% and branch coverage >= 98%, preserving the verified v0.1 quality level above the historical 95% and 90% SRS floor.
At Slice 0033, the eight coarse ownership groups were reallocated to independently verifiable Slices 0033 through 0062 without changing requirement text, priority, membership, or fingerprint.

At Slice 0060, the remaining Vertical Integration roadmap was reallocated from four coarse Slices 0061 through 0064 to independently verifiable Slices 0061 through 0069 without changing requirement text, priority, membership, or fingerprint.
